record.title: Project PIs and Data Managers can import existing Mentoring Institute admins into a project roster to issue one-time sign-in codes or overwrite their global profiles
record.description: Mentoring-institute staff and institute administrators are stored in `MapMentorInstituteUser` (`app/models/mas_mentor_institute.py:71-100`), where `is_admin=True` grants `mentor_institute_admin` authority (`app/models/va_users.py:326-330`, `app/decorators/role_required.py:83`) over `/admin/api/mentor-institutes/<code>/staff` (`app/routes/admin_mentor_institute.py:92-191`) without creating a `VaUserAccessGrants` row. While `app/routes/data_management.py:1080` explicitly checks `mentors.member_user_ids` to prevent Data Managers from editing unassigned mentoring-institute accounts, both `app/services/project_user_import_service.py` (`prepare_members` at lines 645-755) and `app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py` (`may_issue_code`, `_roster_rule`, `issuable_user_ids`, `editable_user_ids`, `_outside_member`, and `may_issue_code_from_data_management` at lines 118-319) completely omit `MapMentorInstituteUser`. Consequently, a `project_pi` or project-scope `data_manager` of any organization-mode project can import a `mentor_institute_admin` (or mentoring-institute staff member) into `MapProjectMember` via `POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/members/import`, issue a one-time 8-character sign-in code via `POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/<target_user_id>/sign-in-code` for an unverified or mobile-only `mentor_institute_admin` and redeem it at `POST /valogin/code` or `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-code/redeem` to reset their password and take over their account, or overwrite a verified `mentor_institute_admin`'s global profile (`name`, `year_of_birth`, `sex`, `vacode_language`) via `PATCH /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/<target_user_id>/profile`.
record.claimed_root_cause: `app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py` (`may_issue_code`, `_roster_rule`, `issuable_user_ids`, `editable_user_ids`, `_outside_member`, `may_issue_code_from_data_management`) and `app/services/project_user_import_service.py` (`prepare_members`) check only `VaUserAccessGrants` and `MapProjectMember` for outside membership or privileged roles, ignoring active `MapMentorInstituteUser` memberships and `MapMentorInstituteUser.is_admin`.

trace.description: Accepts a CSV or XLSX upload at POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/members/import from a project_pi or project-scope data_manager and calls user_import.prepare_members at line 1782.
Matches an existing active VaUsers account by email or mobile_login and marks it action='add_existing' without checking whether the user is in MapMentorInstituteUser or is a mentor_institute_admin.
Inserts MapProjectMember(project_id=project_id, user_id=user.user_id, added_by_user_id=actor_user_id), placing the mentoring-institute admin or staff account onto project_id's roster.

Evaluates on_project_roster(project_id, user_id_col), sa.not_(_outside_member(user_id_col, managed_projects)), and sa.or_(rule_a, rule_b). Because MapMentorInstituteUser is neither a VaUserAccessGrants row nor checked by _outside_member (line 262), an unplaced or in-project-granted mentor_institute_admin satisfies _roster_rule.

Permits a non-admin project_pi or project-scope data_manager to issue a sign-in code for any account satisfying _roster_rule that has no live phone session and no verified email; editable_user_ids (line 231) permits editing any active account satisfying _roster_rule regardless of email verification.

Calls mobile_sign_in_service.issue_code and returns the plaintext 8-character sign-in code for the target mentor_institute_admin (redeemable at POST /valogin/code or POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-code/redeem to overwrite the user's password), while admin_project_user_panel_profile (line 1639) allows overwriting global profile fields via may_edit_account.

evidence.description: MapMentorInstituteUser stores mentoring-institute staff memberships and the is_admin flag (line 92) outside VaUserAccessGrants and MapProjectMember.

mentor_institute_create_staff and mentor_institute_remove_staff (line 166) are gated by @role_required('admin', 'mentor_institute_admin'), granting institute admins authority to create and remove institute staff.
_dm_can_manage_user_profile explicitly checks target_user.user_id not in mentors.member_user_ids([target_user.user_id]) to block Data Managers from managing unassigned mentoring-institute accounts.
prepare_members matches existing active users by email or mobile and adds them to MapProjectMember without checking mentors.member_user_ids.
_outside_member checks only MapProjectMember for memberships outside the actor's managed projects, omitting active MapMentorInstituteUser memberships.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution is unavailable on this VM (predeclared promotion allowlist is empty), preventing live execution of a local reproduction against the Flask test client and database.

validation_plan.local: In an isolated test database, create an active organization-mode project P1 with a project_pi (or project-scope data_manager) actor, and an active MasMentorInstitute M1 with an active MapMentorInstituteUser(is_admin=True) user U1 (both unverified-email/mobile-only and verified-email variants). As the P1 project_pi, POST a CSV containing U1's email/mobile with dry_run=0 to /admin/api/projects/P1/users-grid/members/import and verify HTTP 200 with added=1. Then POST to /admin/api/projects/P1/users-grid/<U1.user_id>/sign-in-code (for the unverified/mobile-only U1) to confirm HTTP 200 returning a sign_in_code that redeems at POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in-code/redeem, and PATCH /admin/api/projects/P1/users-grid/<U1.user_id>/profile (for the verified-email U1) to confirm HTTP 200 modifying U1's global name and vacode_language.
validation_plan.deployment: Do not test exploitation on staging or production. Inspect AuthSecurityEvent rows in the database for event_type='project_member_added' joined with MapMentorInstituteUser on user_id where MapMentorInstituteUser.is_active is true, and check for subsequent 'mobile_code_issued' or 'account_profile_changed' events with detail->>'via' = 'project_roster' targeting mentoring-institute members.
